question: Anjani can do a certain piece of work in 12 days. Anjani and Khushbu can together do the same work in 9 days, and Anjani, Khushbu and Sushmita can do the same work together in 8 days. In how many days can Anjani and Sushmita do the same work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Anjani (A) can do the work in 12 days

Anjani + Khushbu (A + K) can do the work in 9 days

Anjani + Khushbu + Sushmita (A + K + S) can do the work in 8 days

**Formula Used:**

Total work = LCM of individual times

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Required efficiency = A + S

Time = Total work ÷ Efficiency
